settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.content: Here you'll find details about lead times, custom commissions, care instructions, and more.

settings.title: How long does a custom piece take?
settings.content: Custom orders usually take 3-4 weeks, allowing time for sketching, layered pours, curing, and finishing details.

settings.title: Do the lights include batteries?
settings.content: Yes! Your glowing house scenes arrive with replaceable batteries and simple on/off switches.

settings.title: Can I request a specific quote or colour palette?
settings.content: Absolutely—share your ideas via the contact form and Alison will confirm the possibilities.
